name: Published Template ESC4 Modification
description: Principal has ESC4 capabilities on an already-published template

esc4.description: Ability to modify certificate template that is already published on CA

prerequisites: Target certificate template is already published/enabled on Certificate Authority
Principal has ESC4 modification rights on the published template
No ESC5 (CA publishing) capabilities required since template is already published
Certificate Authority is accessible for enrollment
steps: Identify published certificate template with ESC4 modification rights
Modify template to enable Client Authentication EKU (1.3.6.1.5.5.7.3.2)
Optionally modify template enrollment permissions to include attacker
Enroll malicious certificate with domain admin SAN
Use certificate for authentication and privilege escalation

templateModifications.purpose: Enable authentication capabilities for the certificate
Allow Subject Alternative Name specification during enrollment
Ensure attacker can enroll in the template
